Subject: Intro & timing for Redwood demo — VP/CIO attendance?

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. We’d love to get a short technical demo of Redwood set up for your team and confirm whether a VP/CIO-level sponsor will join to help validate the exec value props (latency guarantees, data isolation, and SSO/KMS flows).

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm whether your CIO (or a VP sponsor) can attend? Marcus Lee was mentioned on our discovery notes — is he the right person?
- If so, which of these windows works on your side:
   * Tue Jun 8, 10:00–11:00 PT (full hour)
   * Wed Jun 9, 15:00–16:00 PT (full hour)

If Marcus prefers a shorter briefing, we can compress to 30 minutes and prioritize the exec section + live demo highlights (latency/cost comparisons + security handoff). I’ve attached a draft agenda for context.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

If you prefer, send a calendar slot and I’ll coordinate the sponsor briefing on our side.

Thanks —
Ben

Hi Ben —

Appreciate the note and agenda. Marcus (our CIO) can join but his window is tight — he has a standing commitment at 15:30 PT on June 9. He can do the first 30 minutes of the 15:00–16:00 slot (15:00–15:30 PT). Alternatively, if you can do a focused 30-minute briefing on Jun 8 at 10:00–10:30 PT, that would also work.

A couple of specifics Marcus wants covered: a short latency snapshot for our model sizes, and an outline of the VPC/private deployment SSO/KMS flow. Also can you attach any brief security notes?

I dropped a tentative calendar hold for Jun 9 15:00 PT here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=novapulse-hold-456
